Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a logical error in comparing the years. It stated that "Lo Zappatore was released more recently than Placer Sangriento" because Lo Zappatore was released in 1950 and Placer Sangriento in 1967. This is incorrect; 1967 is more recent than 1950. Therefore, Placer Sangriento is the film released more recently, but the Planner concluded the opposite.
